_providersHelp: Login buttons in display order. Each must also be enabled in Supabase › Auth › Providers (Backend/README.md), otherwise its button shows an error.
_supportEmailHelp: Help & feedback › Contact support. Empty = row hidden (see LAUNCH_TODO.md).
_shareURLHelp: Add "shareURL" (website or App Store page) at launch. Missing = Share rows hidden; the invite message is sent without a link.
_feedbackURLHelp: Help & feedback › Suggest a feature: the GitHub Pages feedback board, e.g. https://jorenaerts.github.io/Earn-It/feedback/. Empty = row hidden (see LAUNCH_TODO.md).
